title: How to record a gap around a door
body:
## How should a homeowner record a door gap?
Photograph the gap around the closed door, then label the photo with the door location and the date. Include a wider photo showing which door you inspected.

## What should the note contain?
Write the door location, the inspection date, and a short description of the visible gap in the inspection note.

title: What to include in an inspection request
body:
## What should an inspection request include?
Include the property address, the concern you want inspected, and your preferred contact method in the inspection request. Attach a photo if you can photograph the concern without approaching it.

## How should photos be labeled?
Label each inspection photo with the room or outdoor location it shows. Use the same location names in the inspection request.
